findings.title: Dependabot covers only GitHub Actions; Python CI deps and container images are unmanaged
evidence: .github/dependabot.yml:2-7 only update entry is package-ecosystem: github-actions, directory: /, weekly
ci/requirements-ci.txt hash-pins pyyaml and zizmor (manual updates only)
pins/images.lock 24 pinned images refreshed only by the manual pins/pull-and-record.sh + pins/verify-digests.sh
findings.impact: CVEs in Python tooling or stale/unpatched base images raise no automated PR; updates depend on a human running the manual pin refresh.
findings.recommendation: Add pip/uv and docker ecosystems to `.github/dependabot.yml`, or add `renovate.json` with digest pinning, preserving the hash-pin policy for CI deps.
findings.note: Carried from focused run DEP-P2-001; still present at f9cb67d.

findings.title: Release and SBOM artifacts are integrity-checked but unsigned (SLSA ~0-1)
evidence: docs/security/SBOM_COVERAGE_AND_PROVENANCE.md:99-105 "All are SHA-256 integrity bindings; none is cryptographically signed ... SLSA ~0-1 remains"
docs/security/SBOM_COVERAGE_AND_PROVENANCE.md:115-120 recommended signing/attestation control not implemented (owner decision D1)
findings.impact: Verification proves integrity of the artifact set, not authorship; a party able to rewrite the tree and its `.sha256` manifests produces a self-consistent, apparently valid delivery.
findings.recommendation: Implement D1: an owner-held ed25519/GPG signature over `sbom/SBOM_MANIFEST.sha256` with the public key published and the manifest hash bound in `PACKAGE_DIGEST.txt`, or use GitHub artifact attestations.
findings.note: Carried from focused run SUPPLY-P2-001; still present at f9cb67d.

findings.title: Vendored mct/compose images are unpinned under a blanket waiver
evidence: pins/supply-chain-waivers.json:4-10 waives root mct/compose ref * (reason TB-8 'imported and not deployed', review_by 2026-12-31)
findings.impact: If the MCT stack is ever imported/deployed, floating tags plus docker.sock mounts create supply-chain and container-escape risk.
findings.recommendation: Scope the waiver to specific refs, add an explicit deploy-blocking guard for mct/compose, and remove or justify the docker.sock mounts.
findings.note: Carried from focused run SUPPLY-P3-001 / DET-P3-007; still present at f9cb67d.

findings.title: Vulnerability scan coverage for 12 images is stale/pending, gated only by expiring waivers
evidence: pins/supply-chain-waivers.json:33-45 twelve images in vuln_scan_pending, review_by 2026-12-31
docs/security/SBOM_COVERAGE_AND_PROVENANCE.md:52-59 vuln JSONs from 2026-09-22; 12 newly pinned images have no scan
findings.impact: The gate passes only via waivers; a HIGH/CRITICAL CVE in an unscanned/stale image is not surfaced until the review-by date forces re-review.
findings.recommendation: Run `automation/validation/vuln-summary.sh` in the next patch window, refresh waivers to real dispositions, and add a scheduled scan job.
findings.note: Carried from focused run SUPPLY-P3-002; still present at f9cb67d.

findings.title: Image/SBOM-component license allow/deny gate is not enforced
evidence: docs/security/LICENSE_GATE.md:18-21 'Manual/collection-side coverage (SBOMs, image licenses) remains the follow-up'
docs/security/SBOM_COVERAGE_AND_PROVENANCE.md:88-92,143 image/SBOM license allow-deny gate remains the follow-up
ci/license_check.py gates installed Python distributions only
findings.impact: Copyleft or unknown-license components inside shipped images are not gated.
findings.recommendation: Add `pins/licenses.allow` plus a check over `sbom/*.cdx.json` license fields (allow MIT/BSD/Apache/ISC; deny GPL/AGPL/LGPL/SSPL unless the self-hosted exception applies).
findings.note: Carried from focused run SUPPLY-P3-003; still present at f9cb67d.

report:
Read-only review of the supply-chain surface at `f9cb67d`: `.github/dependabot.yml`, `.github/workflows/validate.yml` (SBOM/provenance steps), `pins/supply-chain-waivers.json`, `pins/images.lock`, and `docs/security/SBOM_COVERAGE_AND_PROVENANCE.md`.

- `validate.yml:103-113` runs `sbom_coverage_check.sh --require-vuln --vuln-waivers pins/supply-chain-waivers.json`, `sbom_hashes.sh verify`, and the publication-chain/digest gates every run.
- `pins/supply-chain-waivers.json` carries a blanket `mct/compose` digest waiver (`ref: "*"`) and twelve `vuln_scan_pending` images, all `review_by 2026-12-31`.
- `docs/security/SBOM_COVERAGE_AND_PROVENANCE.md` states the artifacts are SHA-256 integrity bindings; none is cryptographically signed (SLSA ~0-1).

No secrets were printed.
